programs.title: Locke
programs.desc: Ivan Locke (Tom Hardy) is one of the best civil engineers in England.He has just finished working on a construction site in Birmingham and is driving to London, where he lives.Tomorrow is the most important day of his career so far, and it is related to the project of a gigantic apartment building.While traveling home, Ivan receives one phone call that completely changes his life... Tom Hardy and Steven Knight had already met during the production of the second season of the series about English gangs of the 1920s, entitled"Peaky Blinders".Hardy played the boss of a Jewish gang, Alfie Salomons, and Knight co-wrote the script.

programs.title: Unit 234
programs.desc: Laurie Saltair (Isabelle Fuhrman) arrives for the night shift at her family's remote warehouse with cubicles for rent.She's alone there.At one point, she is visited by a man who introduces himself as Benjamin Salgado (Don Johnson).Despite the late hour, he wants to go to room 234. Laurie asks him to leave, and when he looks into the stall, he is horrified to find a man inside, Clayton (Jack Huston), who has been chained to a stretcher and is about to become an organ donor.It soon turns out that Salgado is not alone, but that they are leading a group of people, ready to do anything to take the kidnapped person with them.Laurie must fight for his life, but also for her own.

programs.title: 4 from there
programs.desc: Another installment of the adventures of people living in a town straight from a nightmare.It is a terrifying place that traps anyone who crosses its borders.Desperate residents fight to stay alive.

programs.title: Sellers 3
programs.desc: Randall (Jeff Anderson) has a heart attack.He goes to hospital.A sudden illness makes him take stock of his life.While looking for a new goal, he comes up with the idea of ​​making a film about the Quick Stop store.

programs.title: The Huntsman: Winter's War
programs.desc: Many years before Snow White's birth, Queen Ravenna (Charlize Theron) observes the actions of her sister, Freya (Emily Blunt), who is in love with a man named Andrew.Soon their daughter is born.Shortly thereafter, the child is murdered.At the same time, Freya discovers that she has the power to control ice.The woman leaves Ravenna's lands with a broken heart.He creates his own kingdom and an army of deadly hunters.There is only one rule in their ranks: never to love.It is broken by two warriors - Eric (Chris Hemsworth) and Sara (Jessica Chastain).Freya decides to separate them.Seven years later, after Ravenna's death, Snow White decides to get rid of the evil queen's mirror, moving it to the sanctuary.Some time later, William informs Eric that the soldiers who were responsible for the expedition have gone missing.The hunter suspects Freya - the mirror could significantly increase her power.He agrees to complete the mission, with the help of the dwarves.

programs.title: The Dark Money Game
programs.desc: The filmmakers talk about changes in American law regarding the financing of election campaigns, and examine the boundaries between a political donation and a bribe.In 1975, congress created the Federal Election Commission (FEC), whose task was, among other things,enforcing the law regulating the financing of federal elections.In 2002, a new legal regulation was created, commonly known as the McCain-Feingold Act, which increased the role of private money in running campaigns.A landmark decision, called Citizens United, was issued in 2010 by the US Supreme Court, abolishing all limits on transferring funds to a selected candidate or political party.
